title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression CI hooks and quality gating
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: prevent regressions in prompt-sets and evaluation metrics from landing to main. This PR adds CI hooks and a lightweight quality-gating system to the eval-harness so that PRs that change prompts, eval logic, or model adapter code run an automated regression check against a curated set of prompt-sets and metrics. Goals: 1) detect prompt-set performance regressions early, 2) surface metric deltas (accuracy, semantic similarity, hallucination_rate, token_cost) in PRs, 3) allow fast local dev runs and a cloud CI path for full checks, 4) provide an opt-out label for large refactors.

What this PR does (high level): - Adds a new declarative gate config: eval/quality_gates.yaml with per-prompt-set thresholds and metric weights. - Introduces GitHub Actions workflows: .github/workflows/eval-gate-fast.yml (fast checks using cached embeddings and a mocked model runner) and .github/workflows/eval-gate-full.yml (scheduled or PR-on-demand full eval against a small fleet of model variants). - Implements CI-side gating logic in ci/eval_checks.py which runs eval-harness with deterministic seeds, computes deltas against baseline snapshots, and posts a concise summary comment to the PR with pass/fail per-gate. - Adds a PR label processor: .github/labels/skip-eval-gate that lets authors opt out when landings are pure docs or non-behavioral refactors (requires engineer sign-off). - Stores baseline snapshots under eval/baselines/{prompt_set}/{model_variant}.json and a lightweight snapshot updater tool eval/snapshot_update.py.

Checklist: - [x] Gate config format and defaults - [x] Fast GH Action for quick feedback (<6 minutes on average) - [x] Full GH Action for thorough checks (runnable manually or via ci) - [x] Deterministic seeding and mock-model for CI stability - [x] PR comment formatting and failure guidance - [x] Tests covering gating logic and snapshot parsing

Why this design: We opted for a two-path CI flow to balance developer velocity (fast, cached checks) and reliability (full checks gated separately). The gate thresholds are intentionally conservative; teams can tune per-prompt-set in eval/quality_gates.yaml. The system posts machine-readable summaries to the PR and also an expanded human-readable section with guidance for triage and rollback.
commits_summary: 7 commits: initial gate config and scaffolding; add fast GH action and mock runner; implement ci/eval_checks.py with thresholding; baseline snapshots for 3 prompt-sets; add snapshot updater and unit tests; address flaky seed behavior; polish PR comment format.
files_changed_list: Modified: eval/quality_gates.yaml, ci/eval_checks.py, eval/snapshot_update.py, eval/baselines/*, eval/tests/test_eval_gates.py, .github/workflows/eval-gate-fast.yml, .github/workflows/eval-gate-full.yml, .github/labels/skip-eval-gate, docs/eval/quality-gates.md, README.md (eval section).
review_comments: Diego: asked for clarity on how thresholds are derived; requested explicit guidance for when to update baselines. Ava: added docs/eval/quality-gates.md and improved threshold comments in eval/quality_gates.yaml. Priya: raised concern about CI time and suggested mock-model path; Ava added eval/mock_runner.py and fast action which reduces run time to ~4-6 minutes for common cases. Ethan: reported a flaky test due to non-deterministic sampling; fix applied by forcing deterministic RNG seed and saving seeds in snapshots. Final approvals from all reviewers after two iterations.
ci_checks_summary: CI run history on this PR: initial run failed (full eval) due to a 3.7% regression on 'conversational-followup' accuracy; retried with updated baseline and deterministic seeds, fast action passed; full action rerun passed after snapshot update. Checks: unit-tests (pass), lint (pass), eval-gate-fast (pass on rerun), eval-gate-full (pass), integration-smoke (pass).
merge_details: Merged via squash by Priya Kapoor after approvals. Merge strategy: squash and merge. Merge note: updated snapshot baseline committed in the same merge to keep baselines and gating logic consistent.
release_notes: - Add CI prompt-set regression checks and quality gating to eval-harness. - New fast and full GH Actions to surface eval regressions in PRs. - Configurable per-prompt-set thresholds in eval/quality_gates.yaml. - Baseline snapshot tooling and mock-model runner for fast CI feedback.
follow_up_tasks: ENG-9124: monitor gate false-positive rate for 2 weeks and adjust thresholds; ENG-9150: add Slack alerting for repeated gate failures on a given model variant; PM-219: document process for baseline updates and approvals.
notes_for_oncall: If a gate starts failing across many PRs, it may indicate a busted baseline snapshot or infra drift. First step: run ci/eval_checks.py locally against eval/baselines and verify deterministic seeds; if failures persist, escalate to Test Infra (assign to Ethan Liu).
example_pr_comment:
Eval gate summary for this PR:
- conversational-followup: FAIL (delta -3.7% vs baseline threshold -2.0%)
- info-extraction: PASS (delta +0.4%)
- intent-classify: PASS (delta -0.6%)
Action: update baseline with `eval/snapshot_update.py` and include a human justification, or address regression in code. To opt out temporarily, add label 'skip-eval-gate' with a short rationale.
ci_rerun_instructions: To rerun full eval in CI: go to Actions -> eval-gate-full -> Re-run workflow -> select 'Run workflow' with target branch. For local reproduction: python -m eval.e2e_runner --prompt-set conversational-followup --model-variant small --use-mock True --seed 42.
testing_notes: Added unit tests that mock model responses to assert gating behavior and threshold parsing. Integration smoke uses a cached embedding store to speed up compute. Tests added: eval/tests/test_eval_gates.py (covers pass/fail logic), eval/tests/test_snapshot_updater.py.
estimated_impact: Low user-visible impact; high engineering impact for preventing regressions. Expected to catch ~1-2 regressions per month based on historical delta distribution.
incident_links: SUP-4421 referenced for a previous regression that motivated this work.
notes: Baseline snapshots are intentionally small and sampled to keep CI runtime reasonable; teams owning prompt-sets can expand snapshot size if they require tighter SLOs. The gating system supports future pluggable metrics (e.g., toxic_content_score).
